changes.description: Every recorded change, by version; only when one setting is read or changed.

effective_from.description: The day that value took effect; absent while it has the value it shipped with.

guide.description: The guide section that explains it.

kind.description: What it holds: switch is "true" or "false"; days and years whole numbers; amount_sgd Singapore dollars with cents; percent at most two decimals; text a fixed text.

lengthen_only.description: A change may only lengthen it.

max.description: The largest value a number may take.

min.description: The smallest value a number may take.

needs_second_approver.description: Under dual control (FM-1): a change waits for another member who holds the approval right to approve it (rev 0.36).

examples: An invoice to a customer with no terms of its own falls due 30 days after its date

scheduled.description: Changes recorded to take effect after that day, by date.

set_by_platform.description: Set by the platform: shown, never changed (FR-ORG-07).

status.description: recommended while it holds the recommended value; changed otherwise.

value.description: Its value on the day asked for, as a string.

version.description: The setting's version: its latest change's, 0 before any. It also makes the ETag.
